site.title: AI Workflows for DDEV Projects
site.description: Knecht boots your DDEV projects on your own server, works the ticket in the running project, and opens a pull request with a preview.

hero.title: Your Agency's
hero.description: A ticket starts a workflow. Knecht boots the project, does the task inside it, and opens a pull request with a preview. Self-hosted, for agencies that maintain many projects.
hero.mascotAlt: Knecht, the robot helper with a CRT screen head

testers.label: These teams are testing Knecht in the beta right now.

integrations.title: Knecht Connects to the Tools You
integrations.intro: A ticket comes in, a result goes out. Knecht boots your project and does the work in a real dev environment.

github.title: GitHub
github.text: From an issue, a label, or a mention.

jira.title: Jira
jira.text: From a ticket or a label.

cron.title: Cron & Webhook
cron.text: On a schedule or a security advisory.

center.label: Let the Knecht Work
center.text: For every ticket, Knecht boots the project and runs the workflow inside it.

comment.title: Comment in the Ticket
comment.text: Links to the preview and the PR.

useCases.title: Use Cases for
useCases.intro: Knecht does every task that you can describe as a workflow. These three show what such a run looks like, from the trigger to the pull request.

update.title: CMS Update with Database.
update.text: Every Monday Knecht boots the project with its database, updates Craft, and checks every link. The PR comes back ready.

boot.label: Boot
boot.title: Project Boots with Database
boot.detail: ddev composer install, DB dump imported

out.head: Pull request #84 on knecht/craft-update-1042
out.body: Update Craft CMS and plugins (run 1042). Link check after the update, 0 of 142 pages broken. Preview runs with a real database.

estimate.title: Estimate Tickets Up Front.
estimate.text: One label on the Jira ticket is enough. Knecht reproduces the problem and writes effort, risk, and a fix back to the ticket.

estimate.label: AI
estimate.title: Effort and Risk Estimated
estimate.detail: Effort 3 h, risk low, one module affected

out.head: Comment in KAN-231
out.body: The cause is a duplicate event listener in newsletter.js. Effort about 3 hours, low risk, one module affected. Suggestion is to centralize the listener in init().

fix.title: Fix Bugs from the Issue.
fix.text: The issue gets a label. The agent reproduces the bug in the running app, fixes it there, and opens a PR with a preview.

trigger.label: Trigger
trigger.title: Issue Gets Label knecht-fix
trigger.detail: #19, dark mode is broken on this site

fix.label: AI
fix.title: Agent Reproduces & Fixes
fix.detail: Bug replayed in the preview, 4 files changed

build.label: Shell
build.title: Build and Preview
build.detail: ddev npm run build, preview updated

out.head: knecht-works-bot commented on #19
out.body: The fix is open as PR #20. The data-theme attribute was missing on reload, 4 files changed, tests green. You can click through it in the preview.

demo.title: Many Projects.
demo.description: Projects, workflows, and runs in one place on your server. A workflow is written once and runs on as many projects as you connect, and every run keeps its log, preview, and result.

discord.title: Knecht Now Has a Discord Server.
discord.text: Questions about the setup, feedback on workflows, show your first runs. We build in the open and answer ourselves.

a.name: Samuel
a.text: v0.7.0 is out. Jira triggers can now filter by label.

b.name: Matthias
b.text: First security update run across 6 Craft projects is done. All PRs green 🎉

c.name: Bruno
c.text: Question: can the estimate workflow also run on GitHub issues?

progress.title: Where Knecht Stands.
progress.intro: What Knecht can do today, what we are working on, and what comes next.
progress.goal: The beta is running. Next up are the Jira integration and more beta testers.

ideaValidation.title: Idea Validation
ideaValidation.text: We tested the concept in a reduced scope. It works.

branding.title: Branding and Organization
branding.text: The name, the logo, the website, and the social media presence are complete.

techStack.title: Tech Stack and Architecture
techStack.text: We made the basic technology decisions and validated them.

dashboardDesign.title: Dashboard Design
dashboardDesign.text: The design for the dashboard is complete. In the dashboard, you make projects and workflows.

prototype.title: Build the Prototype
prototype.text: A prototype exists. In it, you can make projects and workflows with an AI agent.

installer.title: Installer
installer.text: You can install the dashboard on each Linux server.

updateService.title: Update Service
updateService.text: You can install updates from the control panel.

githubTrigger.title: GitHub Trigger
githubTrigger.text: You can set GitHub triggers that start workflows.

knechtLives.title: Knecht Is Alive
knechtLives.text: You can install the Knecht dashboard on a Linux server with low effort, and it gets updates.

sshIde.title: SSH and IDE
sshIde.text: You can make changes in the live preview containers through SSH and an IDE.

feedbackLoop.title: Feedback Loop
feedbackLoop.text: After a workflow run, different feedback functions are necessary to make the output better.

managedHosting.title: Managed Hosting
managedHosting.text: Beta testers do not have to install Knecht themselves. We host the instance for them and take care of updates and operations.

langdockSupport.title: Langdock Support
langdockSupport.text: The agent also runs through Langdock. One API key covers GPT and Claude models, and every request stays in the EU.

agentHistory.title: Agent History
agentHistory.text: Every issue gets its own session. The agent keeps its environment and conversation across multiple runs.

betaTesters.title: Find Beta Testers
betaTesters.text: We look for a sufficient number of beta testers to find problems early and build the final product.

testActions.title: Test Actions
testActions.text: Workflows can run tests for projects. A fix is complete only when the tests are green.

browserValidation.title: Browser Validation
browserValidation.text: The agent examines the bug in the preview and supplies screenshots as proof.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.text: Slack or email sends a message when a run is complete or when it fails.

docs.title: Documentation and Onboarding
docs.text: The docs cover the setup, workflows, and troubleshooting.

noDdev.title: Projects Without DDEV
noDdev.text: Knecht boots projects that do not use DDEV as well.

jiraImprove.title: Improve Jira Integration
jiraImprove.text: The Jira trigger gets more options and better comments back in the ticket.

pricing.title: Price Model and Licenses
pricing.text: You can officially buy Knecht. The price model, the license, and the payment are complete.

updates.title: Building in Public.
updates.description: We build Knecht in the open. Each milestone is published here.
updates.seoDescription: Building in Public, every milestone of Knecht is documented honestly.
